title: Prompt optimisation (GEPA)
prose: Phase 4. Run AFTER deterministic fold-ins saturate — the optimiser spends its budget on what rules cannot express (compositional word order), not on rediscovering the glossary. Prerequisites: a leak-free split of the adjudicated gold (retrieval must not see eval rows); a metric the SME's judgements validate; hard rules frozen AND enforced in the metric; a promotion gate — the optimised prompt ships only if it beats the current guide held-out.
